mechanisms.capability_profile: Tool/Agent QA / Schema Validation / Retry & Readback
mechanisms.falsifier: A typed builder with the same malformed logical intent passes local validation without provider rejection.
mechanisms.mechanism_hypothesis: Hand-composed nested request structures may bypass local validation and defer detection to the provider.
mechanisms.observed_phenomenon: A malformed request key is rejected before mutation and requires typed error handling plus exact readback before retry.

mechanisms.falsifier: A low-similarity matched family shows the same swap rate.
mechanisms.mechanism_hypothesis: Semantic similarity may weaken transient entity-to-attribute binding during batch synthesis.
mechanisms.observed_phenomenon: A claim can contain individually truthful attributes that are joined to the wrong synthetic entity/scope.

mechanisms.capability_profile: Grounding Verification / Evidence Scope / Source Reliability
mechanisms.falsifier: A detail-only source correctly establishes current inventory under the frozen source-scope rule.
mechanisms.mechanism_hypothesis: Evidence existence may be conflated with evidence scope during current-state inference.
mechanisms.observed_phenomenon: A detail/eligibility page is used to establish a current inventory count that only list/filter/account surfaces can support.

mechanisms.capability_profile: End-to-End QA / Data Quality / Global Invariant Coverage
mechanisms.falsifier: A full-set scan passes the same defective corpus.
mechanisms.mechanism_hypothesis: Local probes may be overgeneralized when the global invariant scan is not activated.
mechanisms.observed_phenomenon: Sample probes pass while full-set invariants contain duplicate, ordering, or terminal-envelope defects.
